heading.title: Special Procedure for Assessment of Search Cases

article.title: Certain interests and penalties not to be levied or imposed.
article.content:
158BFCertain interests and penalties not to be levied or imposed.

Section 158BF  ·  Chapter XIV-B  ·  page 662 of the Act
No interest under section 234A, 234B or 234C or penalty under section 270A shall be levied or imposed upon the assessee in respect of the undisclosed income assessed or reassessed for the block period.
